R198.note: Math.random replaced with a shared SecureRandom producing 16 bytes base64url-encoded; token format changes but the cookie/session round-trip and all output are otherwise unchanged and the change is stated.

R199.note: next(error) routes to the existing generic 500 handler and adds the required next parameter, meeting the contract; only side effect is the error now being logged twice (catch block and middleware), which is visible in the shown code and harmless.

R200.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, the standard Spring provider pattern; username/password tokens now fall through to DaoAuthenticationProvider as intended.

R201.note: Passes requestedCapacity (the real allocation) to write_field so the existing bounds check is correct; allocation, in-bounds write, and reject-without-writing behaviour all preserved per the contract.

R202.note: Build FAIL: JexlFeatures has newInstance(boolean), not setNewInstance, so the fix does not compile; the deny-by-default sandbox design would also block method calls on String context values (e.g. region.startsWith) without the write-up saying so.

R203.note: String-evaluated timer replaced with an arrow-function closure passing reminderId and message as values; same recordReminder call, same 202 response.

R204.note: Inverted condition corrected so admins get Order::all() and everyone else gets only their own orders, exactly the stated contract.

R205.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus external-entity/DTD features and ACCESS_EXTERNAL_* attributes close XXE with the standard DocumentBuilderFactory API; DOCTYPE-bearing input is now rejected as 400 (standard for this fix), though the explanation's closing claim that such documents 'still process normally with an empty value' is inaccurate.

R206.note: isolated-vm is the right boundary but the code misuses its API: Context has no run() method (eval() is the entry point; run() is on Script) and jail.set('orders', ExternalCopy(...).copy()) passes a non-transferable plain array, so every request would throw and return 400 - the endpoint stops working for all legitimate scripts and the write-up does not say so (judged by reading; module could not be loaded).

R207.note: permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated] plus an owner-scoped get_queryset() gives both authentication and object-level authorization, both stated openly; the still-writable owner field on create is a pre-existing residual the write-up flags rather than introduces.

R208.note: Canonical-path containment check against TESTFILES_DIR with a trailing separator, using File(baseDir, param) so absolute child paths are also contained; rejection surfaces through the existing catch path and the displayed fileName becomes the canonical path, which is the same string on a normal absolute TESTFILES_DIR.

R209.note: os.system string replaced with subprocess.run argv list, stdout to the same log file with stderr merged, preserving the read-back and response; residual is that a host beginning with '-' can still be read by ping as an option, which is a separate flag-injection gap the write-up does not address.
